subject.title: Windows QuickStart defaults first chat to paid Anthropic model without credit warning

question: What should Windows QuickStart do when Anthropic auth selects an Opus first-run model that may require paid credits?
rationale: The source path is clear, but changing defaults or adding a paid-credit preflight affects provider policy, onboarding copy, and existing user expectations.

options.title: Warn before hatch
options.body: Keep Anthropic Opus available but require a clear pre-hatch billing/credit warning or readiness check before the first terminal chat.

options.title: Change first-run default
options.body: Switch Anthropic QuickStart to a cheaper or beta-safe default model and leave Opus as an explicit model picker choice.

options.title: Accept current behavior
options.body: Document that Anthropic Opus may require paid credits and rely on the after-failure billing copy instead of changing setup flow.

recommendation.title: Warn before hatch
recommendation.body: Keep Anthropic Opus available but require a clear pre-hatch billing/credit warning or readiness check before the first terminal chat.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete is the strongest history match for the Anthropic default policy and setup wizard surface involved in this choice.
